recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If current implementers need additional manifest guidance, handle it with a new tracker against List or another active resource rather than reviving retired DocumentManifest wording.
issue_request: The Published/Persuasive with Modification DSTU1 issue requested allowing DocumentManifest content to reference Composition/List or any needed resource rather than only DocumentReference, Media, or Attachment; its resolution delegates to FHIR-7426.
initial_application: FHIR-7426 was applied in git commit 5d56a4413d4b5e6268bb18be9c5647dc1ae343d1, which changed the historical DocumentManifest content type to Attachment|Reference(Any) and added the EN 13606/List/Composition explanation. No separate FHIR-7427-specific source commit was found.
additional_context: Later Published issues FHIR-33021 and FHIR-39006 moved the current direction away from DocumentManifest: DocumentManifest was retired because IHE MHD moved to List, and XDS mappings/examples were moved to List. Current source/fhir.ini comments/drops the old DocumentManifest build entries and maps DocumentManifest to List; source/history.html records the R5 removal; List.entry.item targets Resource.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source files were changed because the requested broad DocumentManifest content reference was applied historically and the affected resource is not active current-build source.
